result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Package an Appliance

USAGE:
    Fabrica.One package <BUILD> <CONTENTS> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <BUILD>       The build number of the Appliance                       
    <CONTENTS>    The path to the contents of the Appliance (Build output)

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help          Prints help information                                 
    -A, --appliance     The name of the Appliance                               
    -R, --repository    AWS Bucket name                                         
    -P, --profile       AWS Profile name. If not specified 'default' is used    
    -L, --latest        In addition to specified build also generate a 'latest' 
                        version                                                 
    -Q, --quiet         No terminal output                                      
    -T, --test          Just show discovered Options                            
    -Y, --assembly      Entry assembly name. Derived from the contents when not 
                        given

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Create or update fabrica-one's IAM: its own role, and the console's policy

USAGE:
    Fabrica.One setup-iam [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                           Prints help information                
    -b, --bucket <NAME>                  A repository bucket fabrica-one's role 
                                         may read. Repeatable; added to those   
                                         already covered                        
    -i, --instance-role <NAME>           An application instance role whose     
                                         hosts run fabrica-one. Repeatable;     
                                         added to those already trusted         
        --remove-bucket <NAME>           Stop covering a bucket                 
        --remove-instance-role <NAME>    Stop trusting an instance role         
    -c, --console-role <NAME>            The console instance's role, given the 
                                         console's permissions                  
    -P, --profile <NAME>                 AWS profile with IAM administrator     
                                         rights. Default: the SDK's default     
                                         credentials

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Check fabrica-one's IAM, read-only

USAGE:
    Fabrica.One check-iam [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                    Prints help information                       
    -b, --bucket <NAME>           A repository bucket to check coverage for.    
                                  Default: those the role already covers        
    -i, --instance-role <NAME>    An instance role that must be trusted.        
                                  Repeatable                                    
    -c, --console-role <NAME>     The console instance's role, to check its     
                                  policy                                        
    -m, --mission <APP-ENV>       A mission (Application-Environment) whose log 
                                  group and host streams to list                
    -P, --profile <NAME>          AWS profile able to read IAM. Default: the    
                                  SDK's default credentials
